We have weighted pool4 inverse already? not tested. Let's test weighted pool4 inverse_error. That's new.

attempts.rationale: The ranking is unstable and several correlated groups exist, so a robust weighted average over all models should help.
The series is strongly seasonal and ranking is unstable, so a robust non‑weighted median may improve robustness over mean or weighted.
test a different weighting scheme (softmax_neg_error) to see if a sharper weight distribution improves the robust combination for this strong seasonal, unstable ranking series.
The series has strong seasonality and unstable ranking; a simple mean over all models may provide a baseline robust to outliers.
Try a per‑horizon weighted mean using the top‑k mean per horizon handle (w4) to see if horizon‑specific selection improves SMAPE.
The series is seasonal and ranking unstable, so a robust trimmed mean may reduce influence of correlated outliers.
Try a robust DBA combination on the full pool to see if iterative refinement beats weighted inverse-error.
The series is strongly seasonal and ranking unstable; a robust trimmed mean on a smaller, more diverse pool may outperform the full‑pool DBA.
test a robust weighted combination on the small, stable pool4 using softmax_neg_error to see if a softer weighting improves over trimmed mean.
The series is strongly seasonal with unstable ranking; a robust median over a correlated subset (pool4) may reduce influence of outliers and correlated errors.
Try a per‑horizon weighted mean on the small pool4 to exploit horizon‑specific strengths (different models dominate at different horizons) – a different kind of strategy.
The series shows strong seasonality and unstable ranking; a robust weighted combo on the highly correlated pool4 with inverse error may balance models better than the current median.

decision.justification: Selected 'median on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.8385. Series context: trend strength 0.0 and seasonal strength 0.9313; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.103); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.688.
